title: Tamed Mount: Bladewing
text: Mount Grand Grand Ferocious Bladewing Rusted steel and wild sparks, this machine fights as hard as it rattles. The Tamed Bladewing has the following skills: Lv10: Run!Run!Instant30sec CooldownIncreases Move Speed +80%, then gradually decreases it over 10sec. Can't be used while carrying a trade pack. Lv20: Wild ChargeWild ChargeInstant30sec CooldownCharges forward for 3sec, breaking through enemy lines. Inflicts Knockback and Trip on affected enemies. This skill counts as a Push effect. Can't be used while carrying a trade pack. Lv30: OverrunOverrunInstant24sec CooldownCharges at a faraway target, inflicting Electric Shock for 3sec. Can't be used while carrying a trade pack. or OverwhelmOverwhelmInstant10sec Cooldown[Pet Skill] Overwhelm Lv40: Beep Boop BeepBeep Boop BeepInstant45sec CooldownDecreases Attack -30% of enemies within a 4m radius. Can't be used while under the effect of Run! or Wild Charge. or SlamSlamInstant15sec CooldownStrikes an enemy with a strong blow, dealing (varies) Physical Damage and inflicting Stun for 1sec. Right-click to activate auto-use. Can't be used while charging, airborne, or carrying a trade pack. Use: Summons a mount.
